svg.text: • Scale: 50M DAU, 100M products, 20 page views/user/day → ~11k req/s average, ~35k peak; ~50 events/user/day → ~29k events/s (the video said ~100k)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Freshness requirement: recommendations reflect behaviour within 5 minutes; filters: out-of-stock and already-purchased

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Unhappy path: cold start / no user id → fall back to contextual signals (current category, device, geo, trending)
